title: Flat Troll Blue Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder - 5.5-Inch Solid Brass Countertop Stand, Contemporary Bathroom Accessory, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Flat Troll Blue, keep toilet tissue within easy reach when wall space is limited—this countertop vanity top holder delivers a clean, modern look, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs. to coordinate with your bathroom.

  • Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Protects your countertop with a felt pad to help prevent scratching
  • Complements modern bathroom hardware with a contemporary, minimalist profile
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives

Specs

  • Product type: Vanity top toilet tissue holder (countertop)
  • Material: Brass
  • Style: Contemporary
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 5.5 in x 6 in x 5 in
  • Product weight: 4 lb
  • Mounting type: Countertop
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom by coordinating with other contemporary bath accessories in matching finishes.
